sentences.text: 내일 여행 갈 생각에 너무 설레요. = I'm so excited thinking about tomorrow's trip.
내 생일을 잊어버려서 좀 서운했어. = I felt a bit hurt that you forgot my birthday.
강아지가 너무 귀여워요! = The puppy is so cute!
혼자 살면 가끔 외로워요. = When you live alone, you sometimes feel lonely.
이 영화 진짜 무서워요. = This movie is really scary.
아침부터 버스를 놓쳐서 짜증났어. = I missed the bus this morning, so I was annoyed.
고향 음식이 그리워요. = I miss the food from my hometown.
오늘 일이 너무 힘들었어요. = Work was really hard today.
너랑 있으면 행복해. = I'm happy when I'm with you.
이 영상 너무 웃겨요. = This video is so funny.
영화 보다가 울었어요. = I cried while watching the movie.
와 줘서 고마워. = Thanks for coming.
너무 걱정하지 마세요. = Don't worry too much.
그 말을 한 걸 후회해요. = I regret saying that.
첫눈에 반했어요. = I fell for them at first sight.
결과를 보고 좀 실망했어요. = I was a bit disappointed when I saw the result.
네가 정말 자랑스러워. = I'm really proud of you.
오늘 기분이 어때요? = How are you feeling today?
그 노래를 들으면 눈물이 나요. = When I hear that song, I tear up.
